ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin (Agenda) pre-encryption recovery sabotage: bcdedit safeboot + shadow wipe + backup-service stop chain
ucs.description: Hunts the very specific pre-encryption sequence Qilin operators run on the final detonation host: forcing a Safe Mode reboot with networking, wiping VSS shadow copies via vssadmin/wmic, killing recovery on the BCD store, and stopping Veeam/SQL/Exchange/backup services before dropping the Rust-based encryptor. The bcdedit /set {default} safeboot Network + shadow purge combo on the same host within minutes is essentially a Qilin / Agenda fingerprint (also seen in BlackCat affiliates but rare elsewhere).

ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
let RecoverySabotage = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("safeboot","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","recoveryenabled no"))
         or (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadows")
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
         or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("catalog","backup","systemstatebackup"))
         or (FileName in~ ("net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe","taskkill.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("veeam","vss","sqlserver","mssql","msexchange","backup","acronis","sophos","defender","sentinel"))
    | extend Activity = case(
        FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe", "safeboot_bcd",
        FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" or FileName =~ "wmic.exe", "shadow_wipe",
        FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe", "backup_wipe",
        "service_stop")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, Activity;
RecoverySabotage
| summarize StartTime = min(Timestamp), EndTime = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctActivities = dcount(Activity),
            Activities = make_set(Activity),
            CommandLines = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 25),
            Binaries = make_set(FileName),
            Users = make_set(AccountName)
            by DeviceName, DeviceId, bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
| where DistinctActivities >= 3  // safeboot + shadow + service-stop = Qilin signature
| order by StartTime desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin Chrome credential harvest via GPO-deployed PowerShell logon script (IpSwitcher / 'LOGOGON.bat' pattern)
ucs.description: Detects Qilin's distinctive credential-access tradecraft from Sophos's July 2024 disclosure: after compromising the DC, operators push a Group Policy that drops a PowerShell script (often named IpSwitcher, LOGOGON.bat, or similar) onto every endpoint via SYSVOL, which on user logon copies Chrome's Login Data and Local State files plus runs reg save on SAM/SYSTEM/SECURITY, staging them in C:\Windows\Temp\ for exfil. This GPO-driven mass Chrome scraping is a Qilin novelty among RaaS crews.

ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowMinutes = 15m;
let GpoInitiated = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("gpscript.exe","userinit.exe","svchost.exe","explorer.exe")
         or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("\\SYSVOL\\","\\GroupPolicy\\","\\Machine\\Scripts\\","\\User\\Scripts\\")
         or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has "\\SYSVOL\\";
let ChromeScrape = GpoInitiated
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","xcopy.exe","robocopy.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\", "Login Data", "Local State", "\\Edge\\User Data\\")
    | extend Activity = "chrome_scrape";
let HiveSave = GpoInitiated
    | where FileName =~ "reg.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "save"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("hklm\\sam","hklm\\system","hklm\\security")
    | extend Activity = "hive_save";
let FileStage = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FolderPath has_any ("\\Windows\\Temp\\","\\PerfLogs\\","\\ProgramData\\")
    | where FileName has_any ("Login Data","Local State","SAM","SYSTEM.hiv","SECURITY.hiv",".save")
    | extend Activity = "staging";
union ChromeScrape, HiveSave
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, Activity
| summarize StartTime = min(Timestamp), HostsAffected = dcount(DeviceName),
            UsersAffected = dcount(AccountName),
            Hosts = make_set(DeviceName, 50),
            Activities = make_set(Activity),
            Cmdlines = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 25),
            Initiators = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine, 10)
            by bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
| where HostsAffected >= 2  // GPO fan-out is the signature — single host = noise
| order by StartTime desc

id: 4a9e3d2c-7b1f-4e88-b9f5-qilinchromehunt

description: Detects Qilin/Agenda ransomware affiliate tradecraft - PowerShell or reg.exe spawned by a GPO logon script that touches Chrome's Login Data/Local State or saves SAM/SYSTEM hives

            - '\pwsh.exe'

            - '\xcopy.exe'
            - '\robocopy.exe'

            - 'Local State'
            - '\Edge\User Data\'

        Image|endswith: '\reg.exe'
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - 'save'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'HKLM\SAM'
            - 'HKLM\SYSTEM'
            - 'HKLM\SECURITY'
    condition: parent_gpo and (chrome_scrape or hive_save)

    - ComputerName
    - User
